trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours. There is nothing extra to do for it and no online play is needed: every trophy is single-player. Follow the roadmap in order — story, side strands, the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and this is the last one to unlock.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, once the story is over. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 100 hours: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest counts, along with 200 of the 277 vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals studied through binoculars. Only 70 of the 80 Challenges are needed, so the hardest ones can be skipped. Most side quests are not required, and collectibles only partly.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. It unlocks through the story alone and cannot be missed. Before the finale, use the chapter-start saves PowerPyx recommends, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. Stunts count toward the 100% checklist too, so most of this progress happens while chasing A Long Road. Work through them district by district in free roam after the story rather than hunting one type at a time.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges are also required for the 100% checklist, so this is not a detour. Learn each challenge's scoring first, then grind the golds one range at a time; a controller with steady aim helps more than rushing.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks questlines. The strands are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus two more stranger lines found around the state. Stranger icons appear as you explore; each strand ends with its own trophy, so working through them one character at a time covers this silver as well. The checklist does not ask for these quests, so they are usually the last chunk of work after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida, and only three full sets are needed, so pick the sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit. Track which cards each set still needs and finish one set before starting the next.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the app whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan before moving on; the scans also help with discovering vehicles. The counter is in the Progress menu, so you can see exactly how far along you are.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and get away. A bank robbery instantly puts you at a 4-star wanted level, so plan the escape before the alarm: a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the red heat zone. Hot Together often pops during these same escapes, since the wanted level is already there.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this pops early in Chapter 1 and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions and this comes on its own. Do the missable first meditation with Lucia before leaving Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Billy's strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub opens from Chapter 2, so pick it up while you are here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Andy's quests (Lucia only), Randy's wish-list cars and Tyrone's strand all open from Chapter 3, and the Snap Gun you need for Sneakthief comes from this chapter too.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed. Three of the named story missions — Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown — are in this chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed. The airport itself matters for Catch Me If You Can later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Andy's quests. The strand is Lucia only and opens from Chapter 3. Work through Andy's jobs as they appear; the final one pops this trophy. Andy's strand also counts toward the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton. The strand opens from Chapter 1, so it can be started early, but the wrecks are spread around the coast and take a while to reach. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story, then returns; he is still around in free roam after the ending, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Billy's quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. The strand opens from Chapter 2. Mudclub events are short, so clear them whenever you pass the club instead of leaving the whole strand for the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List. The strand opens from Chapter 3. Each car is a specific model in a specific place, so check the list, then hunt them in free roam between story missions rather than all at once at the end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest. The strand is Jason only and opens from Chapter 3. The lab raids are combat-heavy, so go in stocked and use cover; the final quest pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The strand is Jason only, and the exact animal is still being confirmed by guide writers, so check a current guide before the hunt. Bret's quest is also required for the 100% checklist, so it has to be done for A Long Road either way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and fly it at least 1 km away from the airport. GameMapa points to the airliners docked at terminals E3/E4 as the easiest target. Expect a wanted level the moment you take it; the trophy pops once you are clear of the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station. The base is guarded, so go in fast and drive the tank out before the response builds. Once you are rolling in the Rhino, the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy's trigger as unknown, so there is no confirmed method yet. The description points at a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view: try the beachfront bars in the evening and any prompt that offers a drink with a view. Check a current guide before spending long on it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy's trigger as unknown, so there is no confirmed method yet. The description suggests driving out of a car showroom through its glass front, in the style of the classic showroom smash. Try a showroom in Vice City and check a current guide before grinding it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. This is a robbery with a specific haul: grab the three valuables, get out clean, and break the wanted level. Plan the getaway car before you walk in.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Keep both characters training in parallel rather than maxing one and then the other.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks how you play — robberies, kills, thefts and the like all feed it — so this builds up naturally across a full playthrough. There is nothing special to do for it; it pops once the count reaches 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy's trigger as unknown, so there is no confirmed method yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, so a failed first try at an activity or challenge may be part of it. Check a current guide before spending long on it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy's trigger as unknown, so there is no confirmed method yet. The description hints at something strange or unexplained happening in the world. It will most likely pop from a random or easter-egg event, so check a current guide rather than hunting blind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy's trigger as unknown, so there is no confirmed method yet. The description points at knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon. Check a current guide for the confirmed setup before grinding it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them needs to be won or finished — just try each one. A single afternoon sampling everything in Vice City clears it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The races are also required for the 100% checklist, so they are not a detour. Learn each course's line first, then race to win; the drone handles like a light aircraft, so brake early for tight turns.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Any vehicle class counts, so pick the races you are best at and win 20 distinct ones — repeats do not count. Race wins also feed the 100% checklist, so this progress is shared.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest. His questline starts in Chapter 1. Fishing challenges are about reeling steadily and not snapping the line; watch Cal's pace and keep your tension in the green and you will out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Beat any one of the 4 video games; three of them are on the TV at home. Pick the game you are best at and play through it once. It also counts toward the 9 activity types Master of None needs.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy that can be missed: after an early Chapter 1 mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. The Progress menu counter goes up by 1, but the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it. You cannot do it again after Chapter 1, so just do it — then find the other 17 marked spots in free roam.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are small feats across combat, driving, exploration and more, and the counter is in the Progress menu. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops on the way to A Long Road; pick the easy ones first and skip the nastiest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level together with your partner. GameMapa's tip is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies give you a 4-star level for free, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. GameMapa suggests the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City. Do not lose the cops between stores, and note the trophy is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles; a WAiNK scan is enough to count one. Scan every new vehicle you see while driving around, and the count climbs fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 models, so this pops well before the checklist is done.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang members at their illegal operations.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which comes from Chapter 3. Go in quiet, take the goods without tripping the alarm, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and try another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Armored trucks run set routes around the state; hit one, grab the cash, and break the wanted level. The 100% checklist asks for more than this trophy does, so it usually pops during the checklist grind.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fogged area is left. It pairs naturally with WAiNK scans, vehicle discovery and stunt hunting, so it usually pops during the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs; 39 operations exist in total. Operations are marked around the map, so work through one per gang. The 100% checklist asks for more than this trophy, so it pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. Marked Bills come from robberies; fences take a cut, so keep robbing and laundering until the cumulative total hits $250,000. The counter is in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count, so this builds up naturally across a full playthrough. If it is the last one standing, buy an expensive car or a full wardrobe and it will pop.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. Garages are bought from property listings; the money comes from robberies and the story, so buy them as you can afford them rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or find, and repeat until you hit 10. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most.
trophies.name: On the Spot
